canberra-51.name: Belconnen Arts Centre
canberra-51.bio: Lakeside arts centre on Emu Bank with free galleries, a 400-seat theatre, a design shop and a café.
canberra-51.coordinates_source: OSM amenity=arts_centre (Nominatim), 3 candidates agree; 19 m from placement point (Wikivoyage listing tag). HIGH
canberra-51.notes: Hours from belcoarts.com.au/visit-us: 10am-4pm Tue-Sun, closed public holidays (limited hours on ANZAC Day). Free entry: only a 2024 CityNews piece quoting the centre says free admission; the official site states no gallery price. Site (belconnenartscentre.com.au redirects to belcoarts.com.au, title Belco Arts). 400-seat theatre and cafe from Wikivoyage.

canberra-52.name: Strathnairn Arts
canberra-52.bio: Gallery precinct in a converted 1920s homestead and woolshed in Holt, with a shop and café.
canberra-52.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=gallery "Strathnairn Homestead" (Nominatim); 20 m from the Wikivoyage listing tag. The OSM leisure=common centroid (MEDIUM, 40 m away) was not used. HIGH
canberra-52.notes: strathnairn.com.au/galleries, /about-us and /shop: homestead galleries + shop open Wed-Sun 10am-4pm; 3 gallery spaces; converted 1920s homestead on 9.5 ha with Woolshed gallery. Free entry from Wikivoyage listing (site states no admission price). Cafe Stepping Stone hours differ (site links to its own page).

canberra-53.name: The Pinnacle Nature Reserve
canberra-53.bio: Woodland reserve in Hawker where trails climb The Pinnacle for views over the Molonglo valley to the Brindabellas.
canberra-53.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing own geo tag (Springvale Drive / summit-lookout area), confirmed by Commons geotagged photo "Pinnacle Sunset.jpg" 21 m away. The OSM leisure=nature_reserve centroid (128 m away) was rejected as a park centroid. MEDIUM
canberra-53.notes: Hours/cost: Wikivoyage (Free; no gates stated, treated as open access; the reserve is in Canberra Nature Park, which has no entry fee). 154 ha, 708 m summit loop, dirt car parks on Springvale Drive, no toilets (Wikivoyage). Agency page found by search, BLOCKED to scripts. No trail length from a route relation was available (Overpass down), so pinned at the summit/lookout point rather than a route midpoint.

canberra-54.name: Shepherds Lookout
canberra-54.bio: Lookout over the Murrumbidgee River at the end of Stockdill Drive in Holt, reached by a short bush walk.
canberra-54.coordinates_source: ExplorOz "Lookout Position" -35.24099,148.97731 (5 dp); the Wikivoyage listing tag is 40 m away. resolve-pin.py returned LOW (no OSM feature; Overpass and Nominatim empty). Two non-OSM sources agree within 45 m. MEDIUM-LOW
canberra-54.notes: VisitCanberra shepherds-lookout page: park at the car park on Stockdill Drive, walk through Woodstock Nature Reserve, 1.2 km return, easy, about 45 minutes; ACT border marked by power lines 3 km downstream; dogs on lead. Wikivoyage says a 600 m walk. 24 hours is an assumption for an open-access reserve lookout (no gate stated). Agency page BLOCKED. pin: LOW per resolve-pin (no OSM feature); point sourced from ExplorOz and Wikivoyage.

canberra-55.name: Weston Park
canberra-55.bio: Lakeside park in Yarralumla with picnic areas, a miniature railway, a maze and mini golf.
canberra-55.coordinates_source: OSM amenity=cafe "Yarralumla Play Station Cafe", Pescott Lane (Nominatim), the park's visitor hub, 60 m from the OSM leisure=park centroid (-35.293024,149.090894), which was not used. MEDIUM
canberra-55.notes: Park itself is free to enter (picnic tables, barbecues, toilets per search of the ACT master plan summaries); the miniature train, maze, mini golf and Farm Friends are run by Yarralumla Play Station (9 Pescott Lane) and charge separately: their price and hours not read, unverified. Open 24 hours assumed for an open park. VisitCanberra Yarralumla Play Station page describes maze, 2.4 km paths, Farm Friends, miniature railway.
canberra-55.ticket_note: Managing agency page (parks.act.gov.au urban parks) blocked to scripts and its exact URL not found; operator of the train/maze is Yarralumla Play Station, a separate business.

canberra-56.name: Calthorpes' House
canberra-56.bio: Furnished 1927 house in Red Hill, shown on guided tours with the Calthorpe family's original belongings.
canberra-56.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum (Nominatim); 11 m from the Wikivoyage listing tag. HIGH
canberra-56.notes: Official page historicplaces.com.au/calthorpes-house (ACT Historic Places): adult $12, concession $10, under 12 free; entry by guided tour only, book ahead. Tours 2026 Jul-Dec are Saturdays 1pm-4pm in 45-minute slots (events.humanitix.com/calthorpes-house-tours-2026). Wikivoyage says Sat Sun 1-4pm and $7 (stale price); the official opening-hours widget did not render, so Sunday tours are unverified and hours show Saturday only and closedDays is omitted: check on the official page. Not in the three-house pass price.

canberra-57.name: St John the Baptist Church
canberra-57.wiki: St John the Baptist Church, Reid
canberra-57.bio: Canberra's oldest church, consecrated in 1845, with a pioneer churchyard and a schoolhouse museum.
canberra-57.hours: Church daily 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; museum Sat–Sun 2:00 PM – 4:00 PM, Wed 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM
canberra-57.coordinates_source: Commons geotagged photo cluster of the church exterior (-35.287647,149.140396, 18 files median ~54 m from the Wikivoyage 4-dp tag). The pin supplied by the run (-35.325383,149.151298, OSM place_of_worship, HIGH) is St John the Baptist CATHEDRAL in Forrest/Griffith, 4.3 km away: WRONG, rejected. MEDIUM
canberra-57.notes: Schoolhouse Museum hours and adult $5 (children free) from stjohnscanberra.org/visit/schoolhouse-museum; closed a few weeks over summer school holidays (VisitCanberra). Church "daily 9am-5pm" is from the ACT Canberra Tracks listing seen only in search results (page BLOCKED): unverified. The church and churchyard are free; only the museum charges, so free:true.

canberra-58.name: Canberra Reptile Zoo
canberra-58.bio: Reptile zoo in Gold Creek Village with over 100 species of reptiles, amphibians and native animals.
canberra-58.coordinates_source: OSM building "Canberra Reptile Zoo" (Nominatim), 25 m from the Commons photo median (-35.190647,149.082458); replaces the LOW photo-median pin. HIGH
canberra-58.notes: Hours: open 7 days 10am-5pm, closed Christmas Day only (canberrareptilezoo.com.au/zoo.toy). Adult 17+ $25 at the door, $22.50 online (reptilesinc.com.au/buytickets, the zoo's ticket page). Site title: Reptiles Inc & Canberra Reptile Zoo.

canberra-59.name: Canberra Walk-in Aviary
canberra-59.bio: Walk-in aviary in Gold Creek Village where visitors feed around 600 birds of nearly 60 species.
canberra-59.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=zoo "Canberra Walk-in Aviary" (Nominatim); 40 m from the placement point. MEDIUM
canberra-59.notes: canberrawalkinaviary.com.au/visitor-info: open every day except Christmas Day, weather permitting; Sep-Apr 10am-5pm (last admission 4:30pm); May-Aug 10am-3:30pm (close 4pm); admission includes food for the birds; adult $20 (effective 1 Jan 2026). 160 m from the Reptile Zoo pin.

canberra-60.name: Pialligo Redwood Forest
canberra-60.bio: Walter Burley Griffin's 1918 redwood planting, Australia's largest stand of mature redwoods, with a 3 km walk.
canberra-60.coordinates_source: OSM leisure=park "Pialligo Redwood Forest" (Nominatim); 2 sources (Wikivoyage tag) within ~250 m; the forest is small so the centroid sits on the grove, and the front car park is on Pialligo Avenue. HIGH per run
canberra-60.notes: Wikivoyage Airport and East: open 24 hours, free, 3 km circular walking track, no bikes or vehicles past the front car park, dogs on lead, no toilets. VisitCanberra confirms the 3 km track and "Australia's largest stand of mature Redwood species", Commonwealth Heritage List. Planted 1918 per Wikivoyage; VisitCanberra gives no date.
canberra-60.ticket_note: No single steward found (Defence is reported as lessee by a Canberra Times opinion piece); VisitCanberra is a tourism board, not the operator.
